name: Vapin Ape Full Spectrum Disposable | Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: Lemon Cherry Gelato by Vapin Ape is described as a hybrid strain featuring a flavor profile that combines sour lemon and rich cherry notes with an earthy pine undertone. The aromatic complexity of this strain is attributed to a terpene profile that includes Limonene, Caryophyllene, and Pinene. Taste & Aroma: Sour Lemon, Rich Cherry, Earthy Pine. Reported Effects: Calming, Balanced, Relaxing
